title: LLM Security in Practice: How to Build AI Systems That Don’t Get Hacked
description:
This session is a teaser for the full workshop coming to AI Native DevCon Fall, November 18–19.

LLMs can supercharge development — but they also open the door to new classes of security risks: prompt injection, data leakage, jailbreaks, and autonomous system failures. Traditional security models aren't enough.

In this preview, Joseph Katsioloudes (GitHub Security Lab) breaks down why LLM security matters, what can go wrong, and how to start defending AI systems today through practical, challenge-based exercises.

In the full DevCon workshop, you will learn:
- Real LLM attack techniques developers need to know
- Defensive strategies to harden AI systems in production
- How to think like an attacker when building with AI
- Hands-on exercises based on real security scenarios
- Patterns and guardrails for safe AI-native development

Speaker
Joseph Katsioloudes — Cyber Security Specialist, GitHub Security Lab
Creator of gh.io/scg (10k+ developers trained)
